messages:
Kira: Heads up — canary rollout for gpu-nodepool in eu-west-1 failed to scale up this morning during the traffic spike. Helm pre-hook timed out and argocd didn't progress. Noting higher 5xxs from model-serving.
Devin: Any error logs from the node controller / autoscaler?
Kira: Pasting the cluster events snippet we got from the nodepool namespace:
```
Warning  FailedAttachVolume  2m (x14 over 15m)  attachdetach-controller  AttachVolume.Attach failed for volume "eni-abc123" : AttachNetworkInterface: Rate exceeded
caused by: RequestLimitExceeded: Request limit exceeded
```
Kira: Also saw EC2 API throttling in CloudTrail around the same time.
Mateo: That's classic ENI throttling + spot capacity shortage. eu-west AZ we use has low ephemeral gpu spot availability right now. Two things to consider: (1) ENI quota per instance family, (2) fallback to on-demand for canary devices.
Nisha: We should avoid a full rollback — canary traffic is small but it's blocking deploy. Quick mitigation: patch the gitops values to prefer on-demand for the canary nodegroup, then sync. Cost hit short term but keeps serving healthy.
Nisha: Example values change (helm values via gitops):
```
nodePools:
  gpu-canary:
    instanceLifecycle: ON_DEMAND
    maxSize: 6
    autoscaler:
      enabled: true
fallback:
  preferOnDemand: true
```
Devin: Created a tiny argocd PR to flip the canary to on-demand + reduce max surge. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/+/42
ci-cd-bot: PR 42 opened by Devin: gpu-canary -> prefer on-demand. Triggering CI.
oncall-bot: Incident created I-2025-2337: canary gpu provisioning failures (assigned to @Kira).
Mateo: Long term: we should request ENI quota bump for that account/region and enable ip-per-pod / prefix delegation on the CNI to reduce ENI pressure. Also consider mixing smaller instance types for headroom.
Kira: I ran `argocd app sync infra-cluster --revision=PR-42` and nodes came up as on-demand. Canary passed smoke check after 12m. Keeping the change as a short-lived hotfix.
Nisha: Action items: 1) quota request (Support ticket #SUP-9987), 2) enable prefix delegation on staging to validate, 3) update runbook to surface `preferOnDemand` flag for canary rollouts.
Devin: Noted cost estimate for 24h on-demand fallback ~ +$1.2k. Fine for incident window.
Kira: I'll hold the PR for 24h and then roll a targeted revert after we confirm quota and CNI changes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
ci-cd-bot: ArgoCD sync finished: infra-cluster -> healthy (applied PR-42).
